replies.greeting: Hello! 😊 I can help with subjects, pricing, free trials, registration, or contacting our team. What would you like to know?
replies.subjects: We make learning fun across three areas: 🔢 Maths, 📖 Your AI-Buddy (reading), and 🎨 Craft & Drawing — for Pre-K to Grade 7. Want to explore them? Visit the Subjects page from the top menu!
replies.pricing: You can start with a free trial and explore all features. For full plan details, check our Pricing page in the top menu. 💚
replies.trial: Getting started is easy! Click “Book Free AI Strategy Call” at the top, create your account, and start exploring 500+ games. 🚀
replies.doctor: We have a Doctor Program! Partner doctors meet families twice a month, chat on WhatsApp, and welcome branch visits. You can apply directly on the Doctor Registration page. 🩺
replies.playgroup: Lovely! You can register your playgroup directly on the Playgroup Registration page. You'll get 500+ games, parent progress updates, and a safe, guided space for little ones. 🧒
replies.register: You can register as a Parent, Doctor, or Playgroup. Just head to the Doctor Registration or Playgroup Registration page — which one are you interested in?
replies.features: Little Champ offers 500+ interactive games, adaptive learning, progress reports, a parent dashboard, and a 100% safe, ad-free space. See the Features page for the full list! ⭐
replies.screenTime: For ages 5–10 we suggest short, focused sessions of about 20–30 minutes, a few times a week. Our games are built in fun, rewarding bursts. 🌳
replies.contact: You can reach our team at 📞 +91 98217 49524 or ✉️ Info@kindergarden.com. The Contact page also has a quick message form and WhatsApp link!
replies.thanks: You're most welcome! 😊 Is there anything else I can help you with?
replies.fallback: Great question! I can help with our subjects, pricing, free trial, registration (parent / doctor / playgroup), or contacting our team. Could you tell me a little more about what you need?
